description: This walk follows a fine section of the Wales Coast Path from Mumbles to Three Cliffs Bay on the stunning Gower Peninsula. The trail runs for about 8 miles, following the waymarked footpath west along a fairly flat path. On the way you will pass Langland Bay before coming to the lovely beach at Caswell Bay. You continue to Pennard Burrows before finishing at the beautiful Three Cliffs Bay, one of the finest spots on the Welsh coastline. There are some wonderful views over Oxwich Bay from the cliff tops here. You can continue your walking along the path on the Oxwich to Three Cliffs Walk where you can visit the wildlife rich Oxwich Bay Nature Reserve.
